# VidFlow

> VidFlow turns a long video or podcast episode into clips, captions, text posts, images, and a blog post, keeps them in a content library, and schedules and publishes them to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, and X from one place.

## What VidFlow does

- Produces clips, captions, text posts, images, and a blog post from one long video or podcast episode.
- Matches the written content to a brand's voice.
- Keeps everything in a content library for each brand.
- Schedules and publishes to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, and X from one place.
- Keeps each brand in its own workspace.
- Lets clients connect their own social accounts through a shared link, without sharing passwords.
- Can require approval before posts go out.
- Imports a CSV of posts, and queues can fill from tagged content.

## Platform status

Facebook, Instagram, X, and personal LinkedIn publishing are live. YouTube and TikTok are in beta: until those platforms finish reviewing the app, posts to them from customer accounts publish as private.

## Pricing

Every plan starts with a 7 day free trial. A card is required to start, and you can cancel anytime.

- Starter, $29 a month: 1 brand, 1 seat, 3 connected social accounts, scheduling and publishing, approvals, AI captions, text posts, titles and descriptions, blog posts, brand voice matching, 150 AI generations a month. No image generation and no clip generation.
- Pro, $79 a month: 1 brand, 2 seats, 10 connected accounts, everything in Starter plus clip generation (120 clips a month, 8 episodes a month), AI image generation, automated flows, bulk tools, 600 AI generations a month.
- Agency, $199 a month: 10 seats, unlimited connected accounts, 500 clips and 2,500 AI generations a month, 8 episodes per brand, everything in Pro. One brand is included, and additional brand workspaces are $49 a month each.
